status: NOT USABLE -- the three B2 zero-shot cases have been retrained on the repaired caches and still do not learn. No B2 zero-shot number is admissible.
why_this_file_exists: INVALID_B2_zeroshot.json records why the ORIGINAL three B2 eval reports are invalid (a mesh-dependent load overstatement). It ends with 'retrain all three B2 cases on the repaired caches'. That was done. This file records the outcome, so that the next session does not re-derive it or assume the retrain fixed it.

what_was_run.protocol: identical to the three B1 zero-shot cases -- geometry B2, train_resolutions 21,33, 400 train and 100 val per resolution, 2000 epochs, validate_every 25, batch_size 8
what_was_run.difference_from_the_first_attempt: --loss_force_norm on. It was missing from this trainer entirely and was added first; report section 9.1 established that once B2's boundary force is FEM-consistent the loss must be divided by the per-sample force scale, and that correcting the force WITHOUT it took B2 from 32.46% to 94.08%.

result.shape: best at essentially the first validation and worse afterwards in all three; early stopping fired in all three
result.eval_errors: 0.87 to 0.89, flat in the mesh to the fourth decimal
result.for_comparison: the three B1 cases under the same trainer and the same protocol reach 0.0658 to 0.0827 on the same metric, and 0.050 to 0.106 on the eval metric

why_1_point_0_is_the_number_to_notice: the metric is 0.5*(rms(e_u)/rms(u) + rms(e_v)/rms(v)); substitute uv_pred = 0 and it is identically 1. A model sitting at 1.0 is predicting approximately nothing. That is not necessarily an optimiser failure: a network that minimises Pi goes wherever Pi's minimum is, so the question is whether Pi's minimum, built from this cache's node_forces, is anywhere near this cache's uv_exact.

what_is_safe_to_say_in_the_report: the caches were repaired and the repair verified mesh-independent; all three cases were retrained under the B1 protocol with the force normalisation section 9.1 requires; the retrained models sit at a combined validation error of about 1.0, which is what predicting zero scores; the cause is under investigation and is not the optimiser settings tried so far.
